title: Visitor sign-in
summary: A themed reception form signs visitors in, looks up their host, logs the visit, emails the host and has reception confirm an NDA when needed.
description:
Visitor sign-in puts a welcoming, branded form on the reception tablet. The visitor enters their name, company and contact details, starts typing who they are visiting and picks the host from the Staff directory table; the host's email and team fill in by themselves.

Signing in shows a success screen to the visitor and starts the Visitor arrival workflow through its Form submitted trigger: it creates a visit reference and a badge number, adds the visit to the Visitor log table and emails the host.

When the visitor will see confidential information, reception gets a task to confirm the NDA, with NDA signed and Visitor refused buttons. A 12-month retention policy is included for the visitor records. Everything is built in, so it works as soon as it is installed.
start: Starts from a form page: open the Visitor sign-in form (/f/<id>) on the reception tablet; each sign-in starts the workflow.
setup: Nothing to configure: install it and open the Visitor sign-in form from Forms (or share its /f/ link on the reception tablet).
Replace the sample people in the Staff directory table with your hosts (or import a CSV).
Optional: apply the "Visitor log: 12 months" retention policy to the Visitor log table, and set EMAIL_PROVIDER so host emails are delivered (the console provider logs them).

steps.title: Visitor signs in
steps.body: On the themed form the visitor enters their details and picks their host; the host's email and team fill in from the Staff directory.

steps.title: Welcome screen
steps.body: Sign in shows a success screen with the host's name and a Next visitor button.

steps.title: Log and badge
steps.body: The Form submitted trigger starts the workflow: a visit reference and badge number, and a row in the Visitor log.

steps.title: Tell the host
steps.body: The host gets an email that their visitor is at reception.

steps.title: NDA when needed
steps.body: If the visitor will see confidential information, reception confirms the signed NDA with the NDA signed or Visitor refused buttons.
